_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): الدُّعاءُ مِفتاحُ الرَّحمَةِ وَمِصباحُ الظُّلمَةِ.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘Supplication is the key to mercy and a lantern in the darkness.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): أحَبُّ الأعمالِ إلى اللّهِ عزّوجلّ فِي الأرضِ الدُّعاءُ.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘The most beloved action on this earth with Allah, Mighty and Exalted, is supplication.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): الدُّعاءُ تُرْسُ المُؤمِنِ.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘Supplication is the shield of the believer.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ الصّادقُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): عَلَيكَ بِالدُّعاءِ ، فإنَّ فيهِ شِفاءً مِن كُلِّ داءٍ .
_source.english: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) said, ‘I urge you to supplicate, for verily in supplication is a cure for every ailment.

_source.arabic: عن ميسّر بن عبد العزيز عن أبي عبد اللّه (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): قال لي: يا ميسّر اُدعُ ولا تَقُلْ: إنَّ الأمرَ قَد فُرِغَ مِنهُ ، إنَّ عِندَ اللّهِ عزّوجلّ مَنزِلَةً لا تُنالُ إلّا بِمَسألَةٍ.
_source.english: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) said, ‘Supplicate and do not say, “the matter has already been decreed”, for verily there is a station with Allah that can only be attained through supplication.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ الصّادقُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): الدُّعاءُ أنفَذُ مِنَ السِّنانِ الحَديدِ .
_source.english: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) said, ‘Supplication is more useful than a sharp iron spearhead.

_source.arabic: الإمامِ الرِّضا (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): عَلَيكُم بِسِلاحِ الأنبِياءِ . فَقيلَ: وما سِلاحُ الأنبِياءِ؟ قالَ: الدُّعاءُ .
_source.english: Imam al-Rida (AS) said, ‘I urge you to use the weapon of the prophets, upon which he was asked, ‘What is the weapon of the prophets?, to which he replied, ‘Supplication.

_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): لا يَرُدُّ القَضاءَ إلّا الدُّعاءُ .
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, ‘Nothing wards off fate except supplication.
_source.cited_from: Makarim al- Akhlaq, volume:2, p. 7, number:1978

_source.arabic: الإمامُ زينُ العابدينَ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): الدُّعاءُ يَدفَعُ البَلاءَ النّازِلَ وَما لَم يَنزِلْ .
_source.english: Imam Zayn al-Abidin (AS) said, ‘Supplication repels descended calamities and those which are yet to descend.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ الكاظمُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): عَلَيكُم بِالدُّعاءِ ، فَإنَّ الدُّعاءَ للّهِ ، وَالطَّلَبَ إلى اللّهِ يَرُدُّ البَلاءَ وَقَد قُدِّرَ وَقُضِيَ وَلَم يَبقَ إلّا إمضاؤهُ ، فإِذا دُعِيَ اللّهُ عزّوجلّ وسُئلَ صَرْفَ البَلاءِ صَرَفَهُ.
_source.english: Imam al-Kazim (AS) said, ‘I urge you to supplicate, for verily supplication to Allah and seeking from Allah repels calamity which may have been destined and decreed with just the execution remaining, so if Allah is supplicated and is asked to avert a calamity, it is averted.

_source.chapter: Supplication Repels Various Types of Calamity
_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): اِدفَعوا أبوابَ البَلاءِ بِالدُّعاءِ.
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, ‘Repel the doors of calamity with supplication.

_source.chapter: Supplication Repels Various Types of Calamity
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): اِدفَعُوا أمواجَ البَلاءِ بِالدُّعاءِ ، ما المُبتَلَى الَّذي استَدَرَّ بِهِ البَلاءُ بِأحوَجَ إلَى الدُّعاءِ مِنَ المُعافَى الَّذي لا يَأمَنُ البَلاءَ.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘Repel the surges of calamity with supplication. The person who is continuously facing calamities is not more in need of supplication than that person who is free and secure from calamity.

_source.chapter: Supplication Repels Various Types of Calamity
_source.arabic: الإمامُ الصّادقُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): مَن تَخَوَّفَ بَلاءً يُصيبُهُ فَتَقَدَّمَ فيهِ بِالدُّعاءِ لَم يُرِهِ اللّهُ عزّوجلّ ذلكَ البَلاءَ أبَداً.
_source.english: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) said, ‘The one who fears the onset of a calamity and precedes it with supplication, Allah will never afflict him with that calamity.

_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): أوْحَى اللّهُ تَبارَكَ وتَعالى إلى داوود (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): اُذكُرْني في سَرَّائكَ أستَجِبْ لَكَ في ضَرَّائكَ.
_source.english: It is narrated in Bihar al-Anwar that Allah revealed to Prophet David (AS), ‘Remember me in the good days so that I may answer [and assist] you in the bad [and difficult] days.

_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): تَعَرَّفْ إلَى اللّهِ فِي الرَّخاءِ يَعرِفْكَ فِي الشِّدَّةِ.
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, ‘Acquaint yourself with Allah in times of ease and Allah will acknowledge you in times of difficulty.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ الباقرُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): يَنبَغي للمُؤمِنِ أن يَكونَ دُعاؤهُ فِي الرَّخاءِ نَحْواً مِن دُعائهِ فِي الشِّدَّةِ.
_source.english: Imam al-Baqir (AS) said, ‘A believer must supplicate Allah in times of ease the same way that he supplicates Allah in times of difficulty.

_source.chapter: Enjoinment of Supplication for Every Need
_source.arabic: فيما أوحَى اللّهُ إلى موسى (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): يا موسى ، سَلْني كلَّ ما تَحتاجُ إلَيهِ ، حتّى عَلَفَ شاتِكَ ، ومِلحَ عَجينِكَ.
_source.english: It is narrated in Bihar al-Anwar that Allah revealed to Prophet Moses (AS), ‘O Moses, ask Me for every single thing that you need, even the grass for your sheep to graze and the salt for your food.
_source.chapter_ar: الحَثُّ عَلَى الدُّعاءِ في كُلِّ حاجَةٍ

_source.chapter: Enjoinment of Supplication for Every Need
_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): سَلُوا اللّهَ عزّوجلّ ما بدا لَكُم مِن حوائجِكُم حتّى شِسعَ النَّعلِ؛ فإنّهُ إنْ لَم يُيَسِّرْهُ لَم يَتَيسَّرْ .
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, ‘Ask Allah for whatever occurs to you from your needs even for the laces of your shoes, for verily if He does not facilitate for it, it will not be facilitated.
_source.chapter_ar: الحَثُّ عَلَى الدُّعاءِ في كُلِّ حاجَةٍ

_source.chapter: Enjoinment of Supplication for Every Need
_source.arabic: الإمامُ الباقرُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): لا تُحَقِّرُوا صَغيراً مِن حَوائجِكُم ؛ فإنّ أحَبَّ المؤمنينَ إلَى اللّهِ تَعالى أسألُهُم.
_source.english: Imam al-Baqir (AS) said, ‘Do not deem the smallest of your needs as insignificant, for verily the most beloved of the believers with Allah is the one who asks [Him] the most.
_source.chapter_ar: الحَثُّ عَلَى الدُّعاءِ في كُلِّ حاجَةٍ

_source.chapter: Supplication is the Key to Granting [of a Request]
_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): إذا أرادَ اللّهُ أن يَستَجِيبَ لعبدٍ أذِنَ لَهُ في الدُّعاءِ.
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, ‘When Allah wants to answer or respond to His servant, He allows him [through divine succour] to supplicate.

_source.chapter: Supplication is the Key to Granting [of a Request]
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): مَن قَرَعَ بابَ اللّهِ سبحانَهُ فُتِحَ لَهُ.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘He who knocks on Allahs door, it is opened for him.

_source.chapter: Supplication is the Key to Granting [of a Request]
_source.arabic: الإمامُ الحسنُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): ما فَتَحَ اللّهُ عزّوجلّ على أحدٍ بابَ مسألةٍ فَخَزنَ عَنهُ بابَ الإجابةِ.
_source.english: Imam al-Hasan (AS) said, ‘Allah has never opened the door of request for anyone only to hold back the door of response.

_source.chapter: The Conditions for the Answering of Supplication: Inner Knowledge
_source.arabic: الإمامُ الصّادقُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) ـ و قَد سَألَهُ قومٌ: نَدعو فلا يُستَجابُ لَنا ؟! ـ: لأنَّكُم تَدعونَ مَن لا تَعرِفونَهُ.
_source.english: A group of people asked Imam al-Sadiq (AS), ‘We supplicate but are not answered? the Imam said, ‘Because you call upon One whom you do not know.

_source.chapter: The Conditions for the Answering of Supplication: Inner Knowledge
_source.arabic: الإمامُ الصّادقُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) ـ في قَولِهِ: «فَلْيَستَجِيبُوا لِي وَلْيُؤْمِنُوا بِي» ـ: يَعلَمُونَ أنِّي أقدِرُ عَلَى أنْ اُعطِيَهُم ما يَسألُونِّي .
_source.english: Regarding the saying of Allah, “so let them respond to Me, and let them have faith in Me” Imam al-Sadiq (AS) said, ‘It means that: “they should know that I [Allah] am capable of giving them what they ask Me for”.

_source.chapter: The Conditions for the Answering of Supplication: Inner Knowledge
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) ـ لَمّا سُئلَ عن قولِ اللّهِ تَعالى: «أُدْعُونِي أسْتَجِبْ لَكُم» فما بالُنا نَدعو فلا نُجابُ؟ ـ: لأنَّ قُلوبَكُم خانَتْ بِثَماني خصالٍ: أوّلُها أنَّكُم عَرَفتُمُ اللّهَ فلَم تُؤَدُّوا حَقَّهُ كما أوجَبَ علَيكُم، فما أغنَتْ عنكُم مَعرِفَتُكُم شَيئا ... فأيُّ دُعاءٍ يُستَجابُ لَكُم مَع هذا وقد سَدَدْتُم أبوابَهُ وطُرُقَهُ؟!
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) when he was asked regarding Allahs verse: “Call Me and I will hear you[r supplications]” ‘So why does it happen that we supplicate and are not answered? - replied, ‘Because your hearts have been treacherous in eight areas, the first of them being that you know Allah but you do not fulfil your right towards Him as is obligatory upon you, so your inner knowledge of Him has not benefited you at all… so then which supplication will be answered for you with this [state of affairs after you have blocked its doors and paths?!

_source.chapter: The Conditions for the Answering of Supplication: Lawful Earning
_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): إنَّ العبدَ لَيَرفَعُ يَدَهُ إلى اللّهِ ومَطعَمُهُ حَرامٌ، فكيفَ يُستَجابُ لَهُ وهذا حالُهُ ؟!
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, ‘Verily a servant raises his hands to Allah [in supplication] while his food is unlawful! So how can his supplications be answered while he is in this state?!

_source.chapter: The Conditions for the Answering of Supplication: Lawful Earning
_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): أطِبْ كَسبَكَ تُستَجَبْ دَعوَتُكَ ، فإنَّ الرّجلَ يَرفَعُ اللُّقْمَةَ إلى فِيهِ (حَراماً) فما تُستَجابُ له دَعوَةٌ أربَعينَ يوماً.
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, ‘Make your earnings lawful and your supplication will be answered, for verily when a man raises an unlawful morsel of food to his mouth, his supplication is not answered for forty days.

_source.chapter: The Conditions for the Answering of Supplication: Lawful Earning
_source.arabic: الإمامُ الصّادقُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): إذا أرَادَ أحدُكُم أن يُستَجابَ لَهُ فَليُطَيِّبْ كَسبَهُ ولْيَخرُجْ مِن مَظالِمِ الناسِ ، و إنَّ اللّهَ لا يُرفَعُ إلَيهِ دُعاءُ عبدٍ وفي بَطنِهِ حرامٌ أو عندَهُ مَظلِمَةٌ لِأحَدٍ مِن خَلقِهِ.
_source.english: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) said, ‘If any of you wants his supplication to be answered then he should make a lawful earning and stop wronging people, for verily the supplication of a servant who has unlawful food in his stomach or has wronged anyone from Allahs creation will not be raised to Allah.

_source.chapter: The Conditions for the Answering of Supplication: Presence of the Heart and its Tenderness During Supplication
_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): اِعلَموا أنّ اللّهَ لا يَستجيبُ دُعاءً مِن قلبٍ غافِلٍ لاهٍ.
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, ‘Know that Allah does not answer supplication from a heedless and distracted heart.
_source.chapter_ar: شُروطُ استِجابَةِ الدُّعاءِ ـ حضورُ القلبِ ورقّتُهُ عِندَ الدُّعاءِ

_source.chapter: The Conditions for the Answering of Supplication: Presence of the Heart and its Tenderness During Supplication
_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): اغتَنِموا الدُّعاءَ عند الرِّقَّةِ فإنَّها رحمةٌ.
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, ‘Seize the opportunity to supplicate during tenderness [of your heart] for verily it is a mercy.
_source.chapter_ar: شُروطُ استِجابَةِ الدُّعاءِ ـ حضورُ القلبِ ورقّتُهُ عِندَ الدُّعاءِ

_source.chapter: The Conditions for the Answering of Supplication: Presence of the Heart and its Tenderness During Supplication
_source.arabic: الإمامُ الصّادقُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): إنَّ اللّهَ لا يَستَجِيبُ دُعاءً بظَهرِ قلبٍ قاسٍ .
_source.english: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) said, ‘Verily Allah does not answer the supplication that comes from a hard heart.
_source.chapter_ar: شُروطُ استِجابَةِ الدُّعاءِ ـ حضورُ القلبِ ورقّتُهُ عِندَ الدُّعاءِ

_source.chapter: The Conditions for the Answering of Supplication: Presence of the Heart and its Tenderness During Supplication
_source.arabic: عنه (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): إذا رَقَّ أحدُكُم فَليَدعُ ، فإنَّ القلبَ لا يَرِقُّ حَتّى يَخلُصَ .
_source.english: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) said, ‘When any of you feels softness and compassion, then he should supplicate, for no sooner does the heart soften than it becomes pure and sincere.
_source.chapter_ar: شُروطُ استِجابَةِ الدُّعاءِ ـ حضورُ القلبِ ورقّتُهُ عِندَ الدُّعاءِ

_source.chapter: Factors that Prevent the Answering of Supplication: Sins
_source.arabic: الإمامُ الباقرُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): إنَّ العبدَ يسألُ اللّهَ الحاجةَ فيكونُ من شَأنِهِ قضاؤها إلى أجلٍ قريبٍ أو إلى وقتٍ بَطيءٍ ، فيُذنِبُ العبدُ ذنباً فيقولُ اللّهُ تَبارَكَ وَتَعالى للمَلَكِ: لا تَقضِ حاجَتَهُ واحرِمْهُ إيَّاها ، فإنَّهُ تَعَرَّضَ لِسَخَطي واستَوجَبَ الحِرمانَ مِنّي.
_source.english: Imam al-Baqir (AS) said, ‘Verily a servant asks Allah his need and it is Allahs way that He either grants it very soon or after some time. The servant sins and Allah, Blessed and most High, says to the angels, ‘Do not grant him, and deprive him of it for verily he has exposed himself to My displeasure and has made himself deserving of My deprivation.

_source.chapter: Factors that Prevent the Answering of Supplication: Oppression
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): إنَّ اللّهَ عزّوجلّ أوحى إلى عيسَى بنِ مَريَمَ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): قُلْ لِلمَلاِء مِن بَني إسرائيلَ ... إنّي غَيرُ مُستَجِيبٍ لِأحَدٍ مِنكُم دَعوَةً ولِأحَدٍ من خَلْقي قِبَلَهُ مَظلِمَةٌ.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘Allah revealed to Prophet Jesus (AS) saying, ‘Tell the community of Israelites that… verily I do not answer the supplication of anyone from among you against whom one of My creation holds a claim of wrong or oppression.

_source.chapter: Factors that Prevent the Answering of Supplication: Oppression
_source.arabic: الإمامُ الصّادقُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): إنَّ اللّهَ عزّوجلّ يَقولُ: وَعِزَّتي وَجَلالي ، لا اُجِيبُ دَعوَةَ مَظلومٍ دَعاني في مَظلِمَةٍ ظُلِمَها ولأحدٍ عندَهُ مثلُ تِلك المَظلِمَةِ.
_source.english: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) said, ‘Verily Allah says, ‘By My Might and Exaltedness, I do not answer the supplication of one who has been wronged when he calls Me regarding the wrong that has been done unto him, while someone else holds a similar claim of wrong against him.

_source.chapter: Factors that Prevent the Answering of Supplication: Opposing Wisdom
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): إنَّ كَرَمَ اللّهِ سُبحانَهُ لا يَنقُضُ حِكمَتَهُ ، فَلِذلِكَ لا يَقَعُ الإجابَةُ في كُلِّ دَعوَةٍ .
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘Verily the Kindness of Allah, glory be to Him, does not contradict His Wisdom, therefore not all supplications are answered.

_source.chapter: The Etiquette of Supplication: The Basmala
_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): لا يُرَدُّ دُعاءٌ أوَّلُهُ بِسمِ اللّهِ الرّحمنِ الرَّحيمِ .
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, ‘The supplication that is preceded by “In the Name of Allah, the all-Beneficent, the all-Merciful” will not be rejected.

_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): إنَّ كُلَّ دُعاءٍ لا يَكونُ قَبلَهُ تَمجيدٌ فَهُوَ أبتَرُ .
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, ‘Verily every supplication that is not preceded by praise [of Allah] is incomplete.

_source.chapter: The Etiquette of Supplication: Blessings upon Prophet Muhammad (SAWA) and his Family
_source.arabic: الإمامُ الصّادقُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): لا يَزالُ الدُّعاءُ مَحجوباً حَتّى يُصَلّى عَلى مُحَمَّدٍ وعَلى آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ.
_source.english: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) said, ‘A supplication remains veiled until the supplicant sends blessings on Muhammad and the family of Muhammad.
_source.chapter_ar: آدابُ الدُّعاءِ ـ الصَّلاةُ عَلى مُحَمَّدٍ وآلِه

_source.chapter: The Etiquette of Supplication: Blessings upon Prophet Muhammad (SAWA) and his Family
_source.arabic: الإمامُ الصّادقُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): مَن كانَت لَهُ حاجَةٌ إلى اللّهِ عزّوجلّ فَلْيَبدَأ بِالصَّلاةِ عَلى مُحَمَّدٍ وآلِهِ ، ثُمَّ يَسألْ حاجَتَهُ، ثُمَّ يَختِمْ بِالصَّلاةِ عَلى مُحَمَّدٍ وآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ ، فإنَّ اللّهَ عزّوجلّ أكرَمُ مِن أن يَقبَلَ الطَّرَفَينِ ويَدَعَ الوَسَطَ إذ كانَتِ الصَّلاةُ عَلى مُحَمَّدٍ وآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ لا تُحجَبُ عَنهُ.
_source.english: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) said, ‘If anyone has a need from Allah, then he should begin by sending blessings upon Muhammad and his family, then ask his need. Thereafter he should seal it by sending blessings upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad, for verily Allah is too kind than to just accept the two blessings [at the beginning and at the end] and leave the middle, because the request for blessings on Muhammad and his family is never veiled from Him.
_source.chapter_ar: آدابُ الدُّعاءِ ـ الصَّلاةُ عَلى مُحَمَّدٍ وآلِه

_source.chapter: The Etiquette of Supplication: Seeking Intercession of the Righteous
_source.arabic: الإمامُ الكاظمُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): إذا كانَت لَكَ حاجَةٌ إلى اللّهِ فَقُل: اللّهُمَّ إنّي أسألُكَ بِحَقِّ مُحَمَّدٍ وعَلِيٍّ ، فَإنّ لَهُما عِندَكَ شَأناً مِنَ الشَّأنِ.
_source.english: Imam al-Kazim (AS) said, ‘If you have a need from Allah, then say, “O Allah, verily I ask you for the sake of Muhammad and Ali, for verily they have a special station with You.

_source.chapter: The Etiquette of Supplication: Acknowledgement of Sins
_source.arabic: الإمامُ الصّادقُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): إنّما هِيَ المِدحَةُ ، ثُمَّ الإقرارُ بِالذَّنبِ ، ثُمَّ المَسألَةُ.
_source.english: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) said, ‘[In supplication] praise Allah, then acknowledge your sins, then ask your request.

_source.chapter: The Etiquette of Supplication: Imploring and Begging
_source.arabic: فيما وَعَظَ اللّهُ بِهِ عيسى (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): يا عيسى، اُدعُني دُعاءَ الحَزينِ الغَريقِ الّذي لَيسَ لَهُ مُغِيثٌ ... ولا تَدْعُني إلّا مُتَضَرِّعاً إلَيَّ وهَمُّكَ هَمّاً واحِداً، فَإنَّكَ مَتى تَدْعُني كَذلِكَ أجَبتُكَ.
_source.english: It is narrated in Bihar al-Anwar that among Allahs exhortations to Prophet Jesus (AS) was, ‘O Jesus, call upon Me with a supplication of a sorrowful one, as if he is drowning and has no saviour…and only supplicate Me by imploring Me, with the supplication being your prime concern, for verily if you call Me like that, I will answer you.

_source.chapter: The Etiquette of Supplication: Imploring and Begging
_source.arabic: الإمامُ الحسينُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): كانَ رَسولُ اللّهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ) يَرفَعُ يَدَيهِ إذا ابتَهَلَ ودَعا كَما يَستَطعِمُ المِسكينُ.
_source.english: Imam al-Husayn (AS) said, ‘The Prophet (SAWA) used to raise his hands and implore and beg [to Allah] just like the poor man begs for food.

_source.chapter: The Etiquette of Supplication: Performing Two Units of Prayer
_source.arabic: الإمامُ الصّادقُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): مَن تَوَضَّأ فَأحسَنَ الوُضوءَ ، ثُمَّ صَلّى رَكعَتَينِ، فَأتَمَّ رُكوعَهُما وَسُجودَهُما ، ثُمَّ سَلَّمَ ، وأثنى عَلَى اللّهِ عزّوجلّ وعَلى رَسولِ اللّهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ) ، ثُمَّ سَألَ حاجَتَهُ ، فَقَد طَلَبَ في مَظانِّهِ ، وَمَن طَلَبَ الخَيرَ في مَظانِّهِ لَم يَخِبْ .
_source.english: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) said, ‘Whoever performs the ablution correctly and thereafter prays two units of prayer, completes its genuflexions and prostrations, sends the salutations [at the end of the prayer], praises Allah and the Prophet (SAWA), then asks his need in the right place will not be disappointed, because whoever seeks good from the right place is never disappointed.
_source.chapter_ar: آدابُ الدُّعاءِ ـ أن يُصَلِّيَ رَكعَتَينِ

_source.chapter: The Etiquette of Supplication: Not to Regard Ones Own Request as Too Much
_source.arabic: الإمامُ الباقرُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): لا تَستَكثِرُوا شَيئاً ممّا تَطلُبُونَ، فما عِندَ اللّهِ أكثَرُ مِمّا تُقدِّرونَ.
_source.english: Imam al-Baqir (AS) said, ‘Do not regard anything that you seek from Allah as too much, for verily what is with Allah is much greater than you could comprehend.
_source.chapter_ar: آدابُ الدُّعاءِ ـ أنْ لا يَستَكثِرَ مَطلوبَهُ

_source.chapter: The Etiquette of Supplication: To Have a High Ambition for What You Seek
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) ـ في وصيَّتِهِ إلى ابنِهِ الحسنِ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) ـ: ولتَكُن مَسألَتُكَ فيما يَعنِيكَ مِمّا يَبقى لَكَ جَمالُهُ ويُنفى عنكَ وبالُهُ ، والمالُ لا يَبقى لك ولا تَبقى لَهُ.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) in his counsel to his son al-Hasan (AS) said, ‘Your request [from Allah] must be for such as will aid you of the things whose beauty and goodness will remain for you and whose evil consequences will not touch you, and wealth will neither remain for you, and nor will you remain for it.
_source.chapter_ar: آدابُ الدُّعاءِ ـ أنْ يكونَ عالي الهِمَّةِ فيما يَطلُبُ

_source.chapter: The Etiquette of Supplication: To Have a High Ambition for What You Seek
_source.arabic: الإمامُ الصّادقُ عليه السلام في سُؤالِ عجوزِ بني إسرائيلَ لموسى عليه السلام: قالت: لا أفعَلُ حتّى تُعْطِيَني خِصالاً: تُطلِقُ رِجْلي ، وتُعِيدَ إلَيَّ بَصَري ، وتَرُدَّ إلَيَّ شَبابِي ، وتَجعَلَني معكَ في الجَنّةِ
_source.english: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) narrated, ‘An old woman from among the Israelites asked Moses (AS) a question; she said, ‘I will not do what you wish until you give me a few things: you cause my leg to work, give me back my sight, return to me my youth and make me be with you in Paradise.
_source.chapter_ar: آدابُ الدُّعاءِ ـ أنْ يكونَ عالي الهِمَّةِ فيما يَطلُبُ

_source.chapter: The Etiquette of Supplication: To Supplicate for Everyone
_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): إذا دَعا أحَدٌ فَلْيُعِمَّ فإنّه أوجَبُ للدُّعاءِ ، ومَن قَدَّمَ أربعينَ رَجُلاً مِن إخوانِهِ قَبلَ أن يَدعُوَ لِنفسِهِ استُجِيبَ لَهُ فيهِم وفي نفسِهِ .
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, ‘When someone supplicates, he should pray for everyone, for it renders his supplication more conducive to being answered, and whoever precedes forty from among his brothers in supplication before supplicating for himself, his supplication for them as well as himself will duly be answered.

_source.chapter: The Etiquette of Supplication: Supplicating in Secrecy
_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): دَعوةٌ في السِّرِّ تَعدِلُ سبعينَ دَعوةً في العَلاَنِيَةِ .
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, ‘A supplication asked in secret equals seventy supplications asked openly.

_source.chapter: The Etiquette of Supplication: Supplication in Congregation
_source.arabic: الإمامُ الصّادقُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): ما اجتَمَعَ أربعةُ رَهطٍ قَطُّ على أمرٍ واحدٍ فَدَعَوا اللّهَ إلّا تَفَرَّقُوا عن إجابَةٍ .
_source.english: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) said, ‘No sooner do four people congregate to supplicate together for one matter than they depart with an answer.
_source.chapter_ar: آدابُ الدُّعاءِ ـ الاجتماعُ في الدُّعاءِ

_source.chapter: The Etiquette of Supplication: Being Optimistic about the Answer
_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): اُدْعُوا اللّهَ وأنتُم مُوقِنونَ بالإجابَةِ.
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, ‘Supplicate to Allah being convinced that he will answer you.
_source.chapter_ar: آدابُ الدُّعاءِ ـ حُسنُ الظَّنِّ بِالإِجابَة

_source.chapter: The Etiquette of Supplication: Being Optimistic about the Answer
_source.arabic: الإمامُ الصّادقُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): إذا دَعَوْتَ فَظُنَّ أنّ حاجَتَكَ بالبابِ.
_source.english: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) said, ‘When you supplicate, be optimistic that your request has reached the door [of Allah].
_source.chapter_ar: آدابُ الدُّعاءِ ـ حُسنُ الظَّنِّ بِالإِجابَة

_source.chapter: The Etiquette of Supplication: Selecting a Suitable Time
_source.arabic: رسولُ اللّهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): خيرُ وقتٍ دَعَوتُم اللّهَ عزّوجلّ فيهِ الأسحارُ ، وتلا هذهِ الآيةَ في قولِ يعقوبَ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): «سَوْفَ أسْتَغْفِرُ لَكُمْ رَبِّي» و قال: أخَّرَهُم إلى السَّحَرِ.
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, ‘The best time to supplicate to Allah, Mighty and Exalted, is the time before dawn, then he recited the verse which is the saying of Prophet Jacob (AS), “I shall plead with my Lord to forgive you”, then he said, ‘He postponed [supplicating for them] till the time before dawn.
_source.chapter_ar: آدابُ الدُّعاءِ ـ اختيارُ الأوقاتِ المناسِبَةِ

_source.chapter: The Etiquette of Supplication: Selecting a Suitable Time
_source.arabic: الإمامُ الصّادقُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): ثلاثةُ أوقاتٍ لا يُحجَبُ فيها الدُّعاءُ عن اللّهِ: في أثَرِ المكتوبةِ ، وعند نُزُولِ القَطْرِ ، وظُهورِ آيةٍ معجزةٍ للّهِ في أرضِهِ .
_source.english: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) said, ‘There are three times when supplication is not veiled from Allah at all: after completion of an obligatory act, during rainfall, and during the manifestation of a miraculous sign from Allah on the earth.
_source.chapter_ar: آدابُ الدُّعاءِ ـ اختيارُ الأوقاتِ المناسِبَةِ

_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): رَحِمَ اللّهُ عبدا طَلَبَ مِن اللّهِ عزّوجلّ حاجةً فَألَحَّ في الدُّعاءِ ، اُستُجِيبَ لَهُ أو لم يُستَجَبْ لَهُ .
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, ‘Allah has mercy on a servant who seeks a need from Him and insists in supplication, whether it is answered or unanswered for him.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ الباقرُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): واللّهِ لا يُلِحُّ عبدٌ مُؤمِنٌ علَى اللّهِ عزّوجلّ في حاجتِهِ إلّا قضاها لَهُ .
_source.english: Imam al-Baqir (AS) said, ‘By Allah, no sooner does a believing servant insist to Allah, Mighty and Exalted, regarding a need than He fulfils it for him.

_source.chapter: What the Supplicant Must Not Do: Supplication for the Impossible and the Impermissible
_source.arabic: ـ الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): يا صاحِبَ الدُّعاءِ ، لا تَسأل عَمّا لا يَكونُ ولا يَحِلُّ .
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘O supplicant, do not ask for the impossible and the impermissible.
_source.chapter_ar: ما يَنبَغي عَلَى الدَّاعي تَركُهُ ـ الدُّعاءُ لِما لا يَكونُ ولا يَحِلُّ

_source.chapter: What the Supplicant Must Not Do: To Seek a Hasty Response
_source.arabic: ـ الكافي عن أبي بصير عن الإمام الصّادق (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): لا يَزالُ المُؤمِنُ بِخَيرٍ ورَجاءٍ رَحمَةً مِنَ اللّهِ ما لَم يَستَعجِلْ فَيَقنَطُ وَيَترُكُ الدُّعاءَ . قُلتُ لَهُ: كَيفَ يَستَعجِلُ؟ قالَ: يَقولُ: قَد دَعَوتُ مُنذُ كَذا وكَذا وما أرَى الإجابَةَ!
_source.english: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) said, ‘The believer continues to remain in goodness, comfort, and mercy from Allah as long as he does not seek a hasty response, then despair and abandon supplication as a consequence. The Imam was asked, ‘How does he hasten?, to which he (AS) replied, ‘He says, ‘I have supplicated since such and such a time and I do not yet see an answer.
_source.chapter_ar: ما يَنبَغي عَلَى الدَّاعي تَركُهُ ـ الاِستِعجالُ

_source.chapter: What the Supplicant Must Not Do: Do Not Instruct Allah about What is Good for You
_source.arabic: ـ رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): قالَ اللّهُ تَبارَكَ وتَعالى: يابنَ آدَمَ ، أطِعْني فيما أمَرتُكَ ، ولا تُعَلِّمْني ما يُصلِحُكَ.
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, ‘Allah, Blessed and most High, has said, ‘O son of Adam, obey Me in what I have commanded, and do not instruct Me about what is good for you.
_source.chapter_ar: ما يَنبَغي عَلَى الدَّاعي تَركُهُ ـ أنْ لا يُعَلِّمَ اللّهَ ما يُصلِحُهُ

_source.chapter: The One Whose Request is Granted without Asking
_source.arabic: عن أبي حمزة: إنَّ اللّهَ أوحَى إلى داوود (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): يا داوود ، إنّه لَيسَ عبدٌ مِن عبادِي يُطِيعُني فيما آمُرُهُ إلّا أعطَيتُهُ قَبلَ أن يَسألَني ، وأستَجِيبُ له قَبلَ أن يَدعُوَني.
_source.english: AbU Hamza narrated, ‘Verily Allah revealed to Prophet David (AS), ‘O David, verily no sooner does a servant from among My servants obey Me in what I have commanded him than I give him before he asks Me, and I answer him before he supplicates Me.

_source.chapter: The One Whose Request is Granted without Asking
_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): يقولُ اللّهُ: مَن شَغَلَهُ ذِكري عن مَسألَتي أعطَيتُهُ فوقَ ما اُعْطِي السائلينَ.
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, ‘Allah, Mighty and Exalted, says, ‘The one who is too preoccupied with My remembrance to ask Me, I give him more than what the ones who ask have been given.

_source.chapter: The One Whose Request is Granted without Asking
_source.arabic: فاطمةُ الزَّهراءُ (عَلَيهَا الّسَلامُ): مَن أصعَدَ إلى اللّهِ خالصَ عبادَتِهِ أهبَطَ اللّهُ عزّوجلّ له أفضَلَ مَصلَحَتِهِ .
_source.english: Fatima al-Zahra (AS) said, ‘The one who sends up to Allah his pure and sincere worship, Allah, Mighty and Exalted, sends down for him that which will be of most benefit to him.

_source.chapter: The One Whose Supplication is Answered
_source.arabic: الإمامُ الحسنُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): أنا الضَّامِنُ لِمَن لَم يَهجُسْ في قلبِهِ إلّا الرّضا أن يَدعُوَ اللّهَ فَيُستَجابَ لَهُ .
_source.english: Imam al-Hasan (AS) said, ‘I guarantee that the one who does not harbour anything but contentment in his heart will be answered when he supplicates to Allah.

_source.chapter: The One Whose Supplication is Answered
_source.arabic: الإمامُ زينُ العابدينَ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): مَن لم يَرجُ النّاسَ في شيءٍ ورَدَّ أمرَهُ إلى اللّهِ عزّوجلّ في جميعِ اُمورِهِ استَجابَ اللّهُ عزّوجلّ لَهُ في كلِّ شيءٍ .
_source.english: Imam Zayn al-Abidin (AS) said, ‘He who does not place his hope in people for anything and refers all his matters instead to Allah, Allah - Mighty and Exalted - will grant his every need.

_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): إيَّاكُم ودَعوَةَ الوالِدِ ، فإنَّها أحَدُّ مِن السَّيفِ.
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, ‘Beware of the supplication of the parent, for verily it is sharper than a sword.

_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): دعاءُ أطفالِ اُمَّتي مُستَجابٌ ما لَم يُقارِفوا الذُّنوبَ.
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, ‘The supplications of the children of my community are answered as long as they have not fallen into sins.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ الحسنُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): مَن قَرَأ القرآنَ كانَت لَهُ دعوةٌ مُجابةٌ إمّا مُعَجَّلَةً و إمّا مُؤَجَّلةً.
_source.english: Imam al-Hasan (AS) said, ‘The one who recites the Quran has a supplication of his answered, be it immediately or later.

_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): سألتُ اللّهَ أن لا يَستَجيبَ دعاءَ حبيبٍ على حبيبِهِ.
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, ‘I asked Allah not to answer the supplication of an enamoured one against his beloved.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ الصّادقُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): أربعٌ لا يُستَجابُ لَهُم دعاءٌ: الرجلُ جالسٌ في بَيتِهِ يقولُ: يا ربِّ ارزُقْني ، فيقولُ لَهُ: ألَم آمُرْكَ بالطَّلَبِ ؟ ! ورجلٌ كانَت لَهُ امرأةٌ فَدَعا علَيها ، فيقولُ: ألَم أجعَلْ أمرَها بيدِكَ ؟! ورجلٌ كانَ لَهُ مالٌ فأفسَدَهُ فيقولُ: يا ربِّ ارزُقْني ، فيقولُ لَهُ: ألَم آمُرْكَ بالاقتِصادِ؟! ... ورجلٌ كانَ لَهُ مالٌ فأدانَهُ بغيرِ بَيِّنَةٍ فَيَقولُ: ألَم آمُرْكَ بِالشَّهادَةِ؟!
_source.english: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) said, ‘There are four kinds of people whose supplications do not get answered: the man who sits in his house saying, ‘O my Lord, grant me sustenance, to whom He says, ‘Did I not command you to seek [for your sustenance]?, then there is the man who has a wife and supplicates against her, to whom He replies, ‘Did I not make you responsible for her?, and a man who has wealth and wastes it, who says, ‘O my Lord, grant me sustenance, to whom He replies, ‘Did I not command you to be economical?…and a man who has wealth and loans it to someone without keeping any proof [of loan], to whom He replies, ‘Did I not command you to take a witness?!

_source.chapter: The Reason for a Delayed Response
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): لا يُقَنِّطَنَّكَ إبطاءُ إجابتِهِ ، فإنَّ العطيَّةَ على قَدْرِ النِّيَّةِ ، وربّما اُخِّرَتْ عنكَ الإجابةُ لِيَكونَ ذلكَ أعظَمَ لِأجرِ السائلِ وأجزَلَ لِعَطاءِ الآمِلِ ، وربّما سألتَ الشيءَ فلم تُؤْتاهُ واُوتيتَ خيراً مِنهُ عاجِلاً أو آجِلاً ، أو صُرِفَ عنكَ لِما هُوَ خيرٌ لكَ ، فَلَرُبَّ أمرٍ قد طَلِبْتَهُ وفيهِ هلاكُ دينِكَ لو اُوتيتَهُ.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘A delay in response should not dishearten you, for verily the grant [from Allah] is proportional to [the sincerity of] your intention, and maybe the response has been delayed in order for it to be a greater reward for the one who asked and a greater bestowal for the hopeful one, or maybe you asked for something and it was not given to you and instead you are to be granted something better sooner or later, or it may have been kept away from you for your own good, for many a matter that you ask for would be detrimental to your religion [and faith] if it were to be given to you.

_source.chapter: The Reason for a Delayed Response
_source.arabic: الإمامُ الصّادقُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): قالَ اللّهُ تعالى: وعِزَّتي وجلالي وعَظَمَتي وبَهائي ، إنّي لَأحمِي وَليّي أن اُعطِيَهُ في دارِ الدنيا شيئاً يشغَلُهُ عن ذِكري حتّى يَدعُوَني فأسمَعَ صوتَهُ ، و إنّي لَاُعطي الكافرَ مُنيَتَهُ حتّى لا يَدعُوَني فَأسمَعَ صوتَهُ بُغضاً لَهُ .
_source.english: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) said, ‘Allah said, ‘By My Might, Exaltedness, Greatness and Splendour, verily I protect My friend by not giving him something in this world that will preoccupy him from My remembrance, and so [that he may continue to call Me] so that I can hear his voice, and verily I grant the disbeliever his wish for him so that he stops calling Me lest I hear his voice.

_source.chapter: The Reasons for a Lack of Response
_source.arabic: الإمامُ الصّادقُ عليه السلام: جاءَ رجلٌ إلى أميرِ المؤمنينَ عليه السلام فقال: إنّي دَعَوتُ اللّهَ فلَم أرَ الإجابةَ ! فقالَ: لقد وَصَفتَ اللّهَ بغيرِ صِفاتِهِ ، و إنَّ للدُّعاءِ أربعَ خصالٍ: إخلاصُ السَّريرةِ ، و إحضارُ النِّيّةِ ، ومَعرفةُ الوسيلةِ ، والإنصافُ في المسألةِ ، فهل دَعَوتَ وأنتَ عارفٌ بهذهِ الأربعةِ ؟ قالَ: لا ، قالَ: فاعرِفْهُنَّ .
_source.english: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) said, ‘A man came to the Commander of the Faithful and said, ‘Verily I have supplicated to Allah, but I have not received an answer!, the Imam (AS) said, ‘You have described Allah in a manner that He is not worthy of being described, for verily supplication has four stages: sincerity of the heart, making the intention, having true knowledge of the means, and being fair regarding the request. So did you supplicate knowing these four conditions? He said, ‘No, then the Imam (AS) said, ‘Then know them now.

_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): إنَّ رَبَّكم حَيِيٌّ كريمٌ ، يَستَحيِي أن يَبسُطَ العبدُ يَدَيهِ إلَيهِ فَيَرُدَّهُما صِفراً.
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, ‘Verily your Lord is bashful and kind. He would be too ashamed for His servant to open his hands to Him [in supplication] and for Him to return them empty.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ زينُ العابدينَ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): المؤمنُ مِن دُعائهِ على ثلاثٍ: إمّا أن يُدَّخَرَ لَهُ ، و إمّا أن يُعَجَّلَ لَهُ ، و إمّا أن يُدْفَعَ عَنهُ بَلاءٌ يُريدُ أن يُصِيبَهُ.
_source.english: Imam Zayn al-Abidin (AS) said, ‘There are three types of outcome from a believers supplication: either it is stored away for him for later, or it is hastened for him, or it repels a calamity waiting to afflict him.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ الصّادقُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): يَتَمَنّى المؤمنُ أنّه لم يُستَجَبْ لَهُ دَعوَةٌ في الدنيا مِمّا يَرى مِن حُسنِ الثوابِ.
_source.english: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) said, ‘The believer would wish that none of his supplications were answered in this world when he sees his beautiful and great rewards [in the Hereafter].

_source.arabic: الإمامُ الصّادقُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): إذا اتَّهَمَ المؤمنُ أخاهُ انْماثَ الإيمانُ مِن قلبِهِ كما يَنْماثُ المِلحُ في الماءِ .
_source.english: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) said, ‘When a believer suspects his fellow brother, his faith disappears from his heart like salt disappears in water.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ الصّادقُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): مَنِ اتَّهمَ أخاهُ في دِينِهِ فلا حُرمَةَ بَينَهُما .
_source.english: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) said, ‘He who suspects the religion of his brother removes the covenant between them.

_source.chapter: Prohibition of Placing Oneself In Suspect Circumstances
_source.arabic: رسولُ اللّه (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): أولى النّاسِ بالتُّهْمةِ مَن جالَسَ أهلَ التُّهْمةِ .
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, ‘The person most deserving of suspicion is he who sits with suspect people.

_source.chapter: Prohibition of Placing Oneself In Suspect Circumstances
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): إيّاكَ ومَواطِنَ التُّهْمةِ والمجلسَ المَظْنونَ بهِ السّوءُ ، فإنَّ قَرينَ السُّوءِ يَغُرُّ جَلِيسَهُ .
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘Stay away from places of suspicion and suspect gatherings, for an evil friend seduces his companion.

_source.chapter: Prohibition of Placing Oneself In Suspect Circumstances
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): مَن وَقَفَ نَفسَهُ مَوقِفَ التُّهْمةِ فلا يلُومَنَّ مَن أساءَ بهِ الظّنَّ .
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘A man who places himself in a suspect situation must not blame those who suspect him.

_source.chapter: Prohibition of Placing Oneself In Suspect Circumstances
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): من دَخلَ مَداخِلَ السُّوءِ اتُّهِم .
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘A man who enters suspect places will be suspected.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): لا يَملِكُ إمساكَ الأرزاقِ وإدرارَها إلّا الرَّزَّاقُ.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, 'No one has the power to withhold or bestow sustenance except the All-Sustainer.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): وقَدَّرَ الأرزاقَ فَكَثَّرَها وقَلَّلَها ، وقَسَّمَها على الضِّيقِ والسَّعَةِ ، فَعَدَلَ فيها لِيَبتَلِيَ مَن أرادَ ، بِمَيسورِها ومَعسورِها ، ولِيَختَبِرَ بذلكَ الشُّكرَ والصَّبرَ مِن غَنِيِّها وفَقيرِها.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, 'He apportions sustenance, abundantly and sparingly, and He distributes them to those in need as well as to those who prosper, and He is Just in His allotment in order that he may test whomever He wishes with prosperity or with hardship, and that He may test therewith the gratefulness and perseverance expressed by both rich and poor.

_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): لا تَتَشاغَلْ عمّا فُرِضَ علَيكَ بِما قد ضُمِنَ لَكَ فإنّهُ لَيسَ بفائتِكَ ما قد قُسِّمَ لَكَ ، ولَستَ بِلاحِقٍ ما قد زُوِيَ عنكَ.
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, 'Do not preoccupy yourself away from the duties incumbent upon you in your bid to secure that which is guaranteed to you, for indeed neither will you miss out on that which has been apportioned for you, nor will you attain that which has been placed beyond your reach.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): لِكُلِّ ذِي رَمَقٍ قُوتٌ.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, 'Every living thing has been given its own provision.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): فهذا غُرابٌ وهذا عُقابٌ ، وهذا حَمامٌ وهذا نَعامٌ ، دَعا كُلَّ طائرٍ باسمِهِ ، وكَفَلَ لَهُ برزقِهِ.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, 'This is a crow and this is an eagle, this one a dove and this one an ostrich. He has given each bird an individual name and has guaranteed each one its sustenance.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): عِيالُهُ الخَلائقُ ، ضَمِنَ أَرزاقَهُم، وقَدَّرَ أَقْواتَهُم.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, 'His creatures are His dependants, for whom He has guaranteed the means of subsistence, and apportioned provisions.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): اُطلُبُوا الرِّزقَ فإنّهُ مَضمونٌ لِطالِبِهِ .
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, 'Go out and seek your livelihood for it is guaranteed to the one who goes in search of it.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ العسكريُّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): لا يَشغَلْكَ رِزقٌ مَضمونٌ عن عَمَلٍ مَفروضٍ.
_source.english: Imam al-Aaskari (AS) said, 'Do not let [preoccupation with] a sustenance that is guaranteed avert you from an act that is incumbent.

_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): إنّ الرِّزقَ لا يَجُرُّهُ حِرصُ حَريصٍ ولا يَصرِفُهُ كَراهِيَةُ كارِهٍ.
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, 'Sustenance cannot be pulled by the greed of an avaricious person nor repelled by the repugnance of a hostile person.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): اِعلَمُوا أنَّ عَبدا وإن ضَعُفَتْ حِيلَتُهُ ، ووَهَنَتْ مَكِيدَتُهُ أنَّهُ لَن يُنقَصَ مِمّا قَدَّرَ اللّهُ لَهُ ، وإن قَوِيَ عَبدٌ في شِدَّةِ الحِيلَةِ وقُوَّةِ المَكِيدَة أنّهُ لن يُزادَ عَلى ما قَدَّرَ اللّهُ لَهُ.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, 'Know that even if a servant was devoid of shrewdness and was feeble in his schemes, it would not reduce the amount of sustenance that Allah has apportioned for him, and even if a servant were to be skilfully shrewd and crafty, it would not do anything to increase the sustenance that Allah has apportioned for him.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ الصّادقُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): إن كانَ الرِّزقُ مَقسوماً فالحِرصُ لِماذا؟!
_source.english: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) said, 'Since sustenance is duly allotted, what is the use of greed?!'

_source.arabic: الإمامُ الصّادقُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): إنّ اللّهَ تعالى وَسَّعَ أرزاقَ الحَمقى لِيَعتَبِرَ العُقَلاءُ ويَعلَمُوا أنّ الدنيا ليسَ يُنالُ ما فيها بِعَمَلٍ ولا حِيلَةٍ.
_source.english: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) said, 'Verily Allah, most High, has abundantly distributed sustenance even to the idiots, so that intelligent men may take a lesson from this and know that the wealth of this world cannot be obtained by work or cunning.

_source.chapter: Enjoinment of Seeking One's Livelihood Through Decent Means
_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): ألا وإنّ الرُّوحَ الأمينَ نَفَثَ في رُوعِي أنّهُ لَن تَمُوتَ نفسٌ حتّى تَستَكمِلَ رِزقَها ، فاتَّقُوا اللّهَ وأجمِلُوا في الطَّلَبِ ، ولا يَحمِلْ أحَدَكُم استِبطاءُ شَيءٍ مِنَ الرِّزقِ أن يَطلُبَهُ بغَيرِ حِلِّهِ ، فإنّهُ لا يُدرَكُ ما عِندَ اللّهِ إلّا بطاعَتِهِ.
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, 'Verily the archangel Gabriel blew into my mind that no soul shall pass away before the depletion of his sustenance in this world, so be wary of your duty to Allah and seek your livelihood through decent means, and let not a delay in your provision cause any of you to seek it through unlawful means, for verily what is with Allah is only acquired through His obedience.
_source.chapter_ar: الحَثُّ عَلَى الإجمالِ في طَلَبِ الرِّزقِ

_source.chapter: Enjoinment of Seeking One's Livelihood Through Decent Means
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): خُذْ مِن الدنيا ما أتاكَ وتَوَلَّ عمّا تَوَلّى عنك ، فإن أنتَ لَم تَفعَلْ فَأجمِلْ في الطَّلَبِ.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, 'Take from [the wealth of] this world that which comes to you, and avoid that which evades you, and if you cannot do this, then at least seek your livelihood through decent means.
_source.chapter_ar: الحَثُّ عَلَى الإجمالِ في طَلَبِ الرِّزقِ

_source.chapter: Enjoinment of Seeking One's Livelihood Through Decent Means
_source.arabic: الإمامُ الصّادقُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): لِيَكُن طَلَبُكَ المَعيشَةَ فَوقَ كَسبِ المُضَيِّعِ ، دُونَ طَلَبِ الحَريصِ الراضِي بالدنيا المُطمَئنِّ إلَيها ، ولكنْ أنزِلْ نفسَكَ مِن ذلكَ بمَنزِلَةِ المُنصِفِ المُتَعَفِّفِ تَرفَعُ نفسَكَ عن مَنزِلَةِ الواهِي الضَّعيفِ وتَكتَسِبُ ما لابُدَّ للمُؤمنِ مِنهُ.
_source.english: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) said, 'Your quest to secure your means of subsistence should be such that it is neither like the earning of a wasteful squanderer, nor like the greedy man who loves and depends on this world. Rather, you must raise yourself from the level of weakness and incapacity, and bring yourself down [from the level of greed] to the level of an equitable and virtuous man, and seek your earning the way a believer should.
_source.chapter_ar: الحَثُّ عَلَى الإجمالِ في طَلَبِ الرِّزقِ

_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): لَو أنَّ ابنَ آدَمَ فَرَّ مِن رِزقِهِ كما يَفِرُّ مِنَ المَوتِ لَأدرَكَهُ كما يُدرِكُهُ المَوتُ.
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, 'If man was to flee from his sustenance as he flees from death, it would find him just as death finds him.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): الرِّزقُ يَطلُبُ مَن لا يَطلُبُهُ .
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, 'Sustenance runs after the one who does not run after it.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): إنَّ الرِّزقَ رِزقانِ: رِزقٌ تَطلُبُهُ ، ورِزقٌ يَطلُبُكَ ، فإن أنتَ لَم تَأتِهِ أتاكَ .
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, 'There are two types of sustenance: the sustenance that you seek out, and the sustenance that seeks you out, which even if you do not pursue it, it pursues you.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ الصّادقُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): إنّ اللّهَ عزّوجلّ جَعَلَ أرزاقَ المؤمنينَ مِن حيثُ لا يَحتَسِبُونَ ، وذلكَ أنَّ العَبدَ إذا لَم يَعرِفْ وَجهَ رِزقِهِ كَثُرَ دُعاؤهُ .
_source.english: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) said, 'Verily Allah, Mighty and Exalted, has placed the believers' livelihoods whence they do not anticipate it to come, and that is because when the servant does not know the location of his livelihood, his supplication for it increases.

_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): لا تَهتَمَّ لِرِزقِ غَدٍ فإنّ كُلَّ غَدٍ يَأتِي بِرِزقِهِ.
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, 'Do not worry about tomorrow's sustenance for every morrow brings its own sustenance.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ الصّادقُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): مَنِ اهتَمَّ لِرِزقِهِ كُتِبَ علَيهِ خَطِيئَةٌ.
_source.english: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) said, 'He who worries about his sustenance is recorded as having sinned.

_source.chapter: Impatience With Regards to One's Sustenance
_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): يقولُ اللّهُ سبحانَهُ وتعالى: لِيَحذَرْ عَبدِي الذي يَستَبطِئُ رزقِي أن أغضَبَ فَأفتَحَ علَيهِ باباً مِن الدنيا!
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, 'Allah, Glorified and most High, says, "Let my servant be warned that if he is impatient with regard to My sustenance, then I will get angry and open to him a door of this world [and its temptations]”.

_source.chapter: Impatience With Regards to One's Sustenance
_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): مَن أنعَمَ اللّهُ تعالى علَيهِ نِعمَةً فَليَحمَدِ اللّهَ تعالى ، ومَنِ استَبطَأ (علَيهِ) الرِّزقَ فَليَستَغفِرِ اللّهَ.
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, 'Whoever Allah bestows His bounties upon must praise Allah, and whoever is impatient with regards to his sustenance must seek Allah's forgiveness.
_source.cited_from: Uyoun Akhbar al-Ridha (AS), volume:2, p. 46, number:171

_source.chapter: Impatience With Regards to One's Sustenance
_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): مَن استَبطَأ الرِّزقَ فَليُكثِرْ مِن التَّكبيرِ ، ومَن كَثُرَ هَمُّهُ وغَمُّهُ فَليُكثِرْ مِن الاستِغفارِ .
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, 'He who is impatient with regards to his sustenance must increase his proclamation of Allah's greatness [takbir or proclaiming allahu akbar: Allah is the greatest (ed.)], and he who worries and frets much [about his livelihood] must increase his seeking of forgiveness.

_source.chapter: Factors that Elicit the Descent of Sustenance and Increase it
_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): الرِّزقُ أسرَعُ إلى مَن يُطعِمُ الطَّعامَ ، مِن السِّكِّينِ في السَّنامِ .
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, 'Sustenance comes to those who feed others faster than a knife can cut though flesh.

_source.chapter: Factors that Elicit the Descent of Sustenance and Increase it
_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ) ـ لمّا قيلَ لَهُ: اُحِبُّ أن يُوَسَّعَ عَلَيَّ في الرِّزقِ ؟ ـ: دُمْ على الطَّهارَةِ يُوَسَّعْ علَيكَ في الرِّزقِ.
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) was once asked how one could bring about an increase in one's sustenance, to which he replied, 'Always remain in the state of purity (Tahara) and your sustenance will be plentiful.

_source.chapter: Factors that Elicit the Descent of Sustenance and Increase it
_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): أكثِرُوا مِن الصَّدَقَةِ تُرزَقُوا .
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, 'Increase your charity and you will be provided more.

_source.chapter: Factors that Elicit the Descent of Sustenance and Increase it
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): مُواساةُ الأخِ في اللّهِ عزّوجلّ تَزِيدُ في الرِّزقِ .
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, 'Helping out one's brother in faith from one's own wealth, for the sake of Allah, increases sustenance.

_source.chapter: Factors that Elicit the Descent of Sustenance and Increase it
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): استِعمالُ الأمانَةِ يَزِيدُ في الرِّزقِ.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, 'Acting with integrity increases one's sustenance.

_source.chapter: Factors that Elicit the Descent of Sustenance and Increase it
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): استَنزِلُوا الرِّزقَ بالصَّدقَةِ.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, 'Attract sustenance by giving in charity.

_source.chapter: Factors that Elicit the Descent of Sustenance and Increase it
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): مَن حَسُنَتْ نِيّتُهُ ، زِيدَ في رِزقِهِ.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, 'He who is sincere in his intention receives an increase in sustenance.

_source.chapter: Factors that Elicit the Descent of Sustenance and Increase it
_source.arabic: الإمامُ الباقرُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): علَيكَ بالدعاءِ لإخوانِكَ بظَهْرِ الغَيبِ فإنّهُ يَهِيلُ الرِّزقَ.
_source.english: Imam al-Baqir (AS) said, 'You must pray fervently for your brothers [in faith] in secret, and sustenance will pour down on you.

_source.chapter: Factors that Elicit the Descent of Sustenance and Increase it
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): الزَّكاةُ تَزِيدُ في الرِّزقِ .
_source.english: Imam al-Baqir (AS) said, 'Paying the alms-tax (zakat) leads to an increase in one's sustenance.

_source.chapter: Factors that Elicit the Descent of Sustenance and Increase it
_source.arabic: الإمامُ الصّادقُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): مَن حَسَّنَ بِرَّهُ أهلَ بَيتِهِ زِيدَ في رِزقِهِ .
_source.english: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) said, 'Whoever is especially kind to his family is increased in sustenance.

_source.chapter: Factors that Elicit the Descent of Sustenance and Increase it
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): إنّ البِرَّ يَزِيدُ في الرِّزقِ .
_source.english: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) said, 'Verily kindness leads to an increase in sustenance.

_source.chapter: Factors that Elicit the Descent of Sustenance and Increase it
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): حُسنُ الخُلُقِ يَزِيدُ في الرِّزقِ .
_source.english: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) said, 'Being good-natured increases in one's sustenance.

_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): مَن حَبَسَ عن أخيهِ المسلمِ شيئا مِن حَقٍّ حَرَّمَ اللّهُ علَيهِ بَرَكةَ الرِّزقِ إلّا أن يَتوبَ .
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, 'Whoever deprives a fellow Muslim brother of his right, Allah forbids him the benediction of sustenance until he repents.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ الباقرُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): إنّ العَبدَ لَيُذنِبُ الذَّنبَ فَيُزوى عنهُ الرِّزقُ .
_source.english: Imam al-Baqir (AS) said, 'Verily when the servant commits a sin, his sustenance eludes him.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ الصّادقُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): كَثرَةُ السُحتِ يَمحَقُ الرِّزقَ .
_source.english: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) said, 'Obtaining wealth through illegal means cuts off one's sustenance.

_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): العِبادَةُ عَشرَةُ أجزاءٍ تِسعَةُ أجزاءٍ في طَلَبِ الحَلالِ.
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, 'Worship consists of ten parts of which nine are to do with earning a lawful livelihood.

_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): الكادُّ على عِيالِهِ كالمُجاهِدِ في سبيلِ اللّهِ.
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, 'He who works hard to provide his family with a lawful livelihood is as one who fights in the way of Allah (jihad).

_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): إنَّ اللّهَ تعالى يُحِبُّ أن يَرى عَبدَهُ تَعِبا في طَلَبِ الحَلالِ.
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, 'Verily Allah, most High, loves to see his servant weary from striving to earn his livelihood [lawfully].

_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): طَلبُ الحَلالِ فَريضةٌ على كُلِّ مُسلمٍ ومُسلمةٍ.
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, 'Seeking a lawful livelihood is incumbent upon every Muslim man and woman.

_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): مَن أكَلَ مِن كَدِّ يَدِهِ ، مَرَّ على الصِّراطِ كالبَرقِ الخاطِفِ .
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, 'He whose daily bread is earned through his own toil and labour will pass across the Sirat [Sirat: the Bridge extended over Hell, described as being as thin as a hair and as sharp as a sword, leading to Paradise (ed.)] as fast as a flash of lightning.

_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): مَن أكَلَ مِن كَدِّ يَدِهِ ، نَظَر اللّهُ إلَيهِ بالرَّحمَةِ ثُمّ لا يُعَذِّبُهُ أبداً .
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, 'He whose daily bread is earned through his own toil and labour, Allah will look upon him with mercy and will never expose him to chastisement.

_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): مَلعونٌ مَلعونٌ مَن ضَيَّعَ مَن يَعُولُ .
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, 'Cursed! Cursed is the one who brings deprivation to his dependents.

_source.arabic: عن المفضّلِ بنِ عمرَ: استَعِينُوا بِبعضِ الدنيا على الآخِرَةِ ، فإنّي سَمِعتُ أبا عبدِ اللّهِ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) يقولُ: اِستَعِينُوا بِبعضِ هذهِ على هذهِ ، ولا تَكُونوا كَلاًّ على الناسِ .
_source.english: Mufazzal b. Aumar said, 'Make use of some of the [commodities of this] world to help you in the next world, for I have heard Abu Aabdallah (AS) [i.e. Imam al-Sadiq] say, 'Make use of some of this [abode] for that one, but do not be a burden on other people.

_source.chapter: The Best Livelihood is That Which Suffices You
_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): اللّهُمّ ارزُقْ محمّداً وآلَ محمّدٍ ومَن أحَبَّ محمّداً وآلَ محمّدٍ ، العَفافَ والكَفافَ، وارزُقْ مَن أبغَضَ محمّداً وآلَ محمّدٍ المالَ والوَلَدَ.
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, 'O Allah provide moderation and sufficiency to Muhammad and the family of Muhammad, and to those who love Muhammad and his family, and provide abundance of wealth and progeny to those who harbour hatred for Muhammad and his family.

_source.chapter: The Best Livelihood is That Which Suffices You
_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): خَيرُ الرِّزقِ ما يَكْفِي.
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, 'The best livelihood is that which suffices.

_source.chapter: The Best Livelihood is That Which Suffices You
_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): ما قَلَّ وكَفى خَيرٌ مِمّا كَثُرَ وألهى.
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, 'That which is little yet sufficient is better than that which is abundant and distracting [as a result].

_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): مَن غَشَّ أخاهُ المُسلِمَ نَزَعَ اللّهُ عَنهُ بَرَكةَ رِزقِهِ، وأفسَدَ علَيهِ مَعيشَتَهُ، ووَكَلَهُ إلى نفسِهِ.
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, ‘He who swindles a fellow Muslim brother, Allah snatches away the benediction in his sustenance, thwarts his efforts at earning a livelihood, and relegates him to his own base self.

_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): مَن باعَ عَيباً لَم يُبَيِّنْهُ لَم يَزَلْ في مَقتِ اللّهِ، ولَم تَزَلِ المَلائكةُ تَلعَنُهُ.
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, ‘He who sells a flawed commodity, not stating it, remains despised by Allah, and the angels continuously curse him.

_source.arabic: الترغيب والترهيب: إنَّ رسولَ اللّهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ) مَرَّ على صُبْرَةِ طَعامٍ، فَأدخَلَ يَدَهُ فيها فَنالَت أصابِعُهُ بَلَلاً، فقالَ: ما هذا يا صاحِبَ الطَّعامِ ؟ قالَ: أصابَتهُ السماءُ يا رسولَ اللّهِ . قالَ: أفَلا جَعَلتَهُ فَوقَ الطَّعامِ حتّى يَراهُ الناسُ؟! مَن غَشَّنا فَلَيسَ مِنّا.
_source.english: It is narrated in Kanz al-Aummal: ‘Verily the Prophet (SAWA) once passed by a pile of wheat, so he placed his hand in and his fingers hit upon some moisture, at which he asked the vendor, ‘What is this O vendor of wheat? to which he replied, ‘The rain fell on it O Prophet of Allah. The Prophet then asked him, ‘Then why did you not place it at the top of the pile that people might see it?! He who swindles us is not of us.
_source.cited_from: Al-Targhib wa al-Tarhib, volume:2, p. 571, number:2

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) ـ مِن عَهدِهِ إلى بعضِ عُمّالِهِ ـ: إنَّ أعظَمَ الخِيانَةِ خِيانَةُ الاُمَّةِ، وأفظَعَ الغِشِّ غِشُّ الأئمَّةِ.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said in his instruction to one of his labourers, ‘Verily the worst act of treachery is the treachery against a Muslim community, and the worst act of swindling is swindling ones leaders [Imams].

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): مَن غَشَّ الناسَ في دِينِهِم فَهُو مُعانِدٌ للّهِ ورسولِهِ .
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘He who swindles people in matters of religion is an antagonist of Allah and His Prophet.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ الصّادقُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): ليسَ مِنّا مَن غَشَّنا .
_source.english: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) said, ‘He who swindles us is not of us.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ الكاظمُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) ـ لَمّا مَرَّ بهشامِ بنِ الحَكَمِ وهو يَبِيعُ السَّابِرِيَّ فِي الظِّلالِ ـ: يا هِشامُ، إنّ البَيعَ فِي الظِلِّ غِشٌّ، وإنَّ الغِشَّ لا يَحِلُّ.
_source.english: Imam al-Kazim (AS) once passed by Hisham b. al-Hakam selling fine cloth in the shade, so he said to him, ‘O Hisham, verily the sale of goods in the shade is considered fraud, and verily fraud is not allowed.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): الشُّكرُ زِينَةُ الغِنى ، والصَّبرُ زِينَةُ البَلوى.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘Thankfulness is the adornment of wealth, whereas patience is the adornment of tribulation.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): أوَّلُ ما يَجِبُ علَيكُم للّهِ سبحانَهُ ، شُكرُ أيادِيهِ وابتِغاءُ مَراضِيهِ.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘The first duty incumbent upon you towards Allah, Glory be to Him, is thanksgiving for His favours and seeking out His pleasure.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ الصّادقُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): في كُلِّ نَفَسٍ مِن أنفاسِكَ شُكرٌ لازِمٌ لكَ ، بَل ألفٌ وأكثَرُ.
_source.english: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) said, ‘Every single breath you take necessitates an essential thanks from you, or rather a thousand thanks or more.

_source.arabic: مصباح الشريعة ـ فيما نسبه إلى الإمام الصّادق (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) ـ: لَو كانَ عندَ اللّهِ عِبادَةٌ تَعَبَّدُ بها عِبادَةُ المُخلِصينَ أفضَلَ مِن الشُّكرِ على كُلِّ حالٍ لَأطلَقَ لَفظَهُ فيهِم مِن جَميعِ الخَلقِ بها ، فَلمّا لَم يَكُن أفضَلُ مِنها خَصَّها مِن بَينِ العِباداتِ وخَصَّ أربابَها، فقالَ: «وقَليلٌ مِنْ عِبادِيَ الشَّكُورُ».
_source.english: It is narrated in Misbah al-Shariaa (The Lantern of the Path): ‘If there was to be an act of worship for Allahs sincere servants to carry out better in the sight of Allah than thanksgiving to Him in every situation, He would have definitely singled out these worshippers for a mention from amongst the rest of creation for their carrying out this special act of worship. And for the very fact that there is no better act of worship than it [i.e. thanksgiving], He has distinguished it from all other acts of worship and has distinguished those who practice it, saying, “And very few of My servants are truly thankful.”

_source.arabic: الإمامُ الهاديُّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): الشاكِرُ أسعَدُ بالشُّكرِ مِنهُ بِالنِّعمَةِ التي أوجَبَتِ الشُّكرَ ؛ لأنَّ النِّعَمَ مَتاعٌ ، والشُّكرَ نِعَمٌ وعُقبى.
_source.english: Imam al-Hadi (AS) said, ‘The thankful person prospers more as a result of his thanks than as a result of the bounty which incited the thanks, because bounties are sources of delight whereas [the ability] to thank is not only the consequence [of the bounty] but a source of delight in itself.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ العسكريُّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): لا يَعرِفُ النِّعمَةَ إلّا الشاكِرُ، ولا يَشكُرُ النِّعمَةَ إلّا العارِفُ.
_source.english: Imsm al-Aaskari (AS) said, ‘None but the thankful one knows the true worth of a bounty, and none but the one with inner knowledge [or gnostic] is truly thankful for a bounty.

_source.chapter: The Role of Thankfulness in the Increase (of Bounties)
_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): ما فَتَحَ اللّهُ على عَبدٍ بابَ شُكرٍ فَخَزَنَ عنهُ بابَ الزِّيادَةِ .
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, ‘Allah does not open the door of thanks for His servant and keep the door of increase shut.

_source.chapter: The Role of Thankfulness in the Increase (of Bounties)
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): ما أنعَمَ اللّهُ على عَبدٍ نِعمَةً فَشَكَرَها بِقَلبِهِ ، إلّا استَوجَبَ المَزِيدَ فيها قَبلَ أن يُظهِرَ شُكرَها عَلى لِسانِهِ.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘When Allah bestows a bounty upon a servant, no sooner does the latter feel thankful for it in his heart than he becomes deserving of increase therein before the expression of thanks has even reached his tongue.

_source.chapter: The Necessity of Thanksgiving for the Ability to Thank
_source.arabic: الإمامُ زينُ العابدينَ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) ـ في المناجاةِ ـ: فكيفَ لي بتَحصيلِ الشُّكرِ ، وشُكرِي إيّاكَ يَفتَقِرُ إلى شُكرٍ؟! فَكُلَّما قُلتُ: لكَ الحَمدُ ، وَجَبَ عَلَيَّ لذلكَ أن أقولَ: لكَ الحَمدُ .
_source.english: Imam Zayn al-Abidin (AS) said in his supplication, ‘So how can I ever achieve thanksgiving?! For my thanking You requires thanksgiving in itself. Whenever I say, ‘To You belongs Praise [Thanks], it becomes thereby incumbent upon me to say, ‘To You belongs Praise [Thanks].

_source.chapter: The Necessity of Thanksgiving for the Ability to Thank
_source.arabic: الإمامُ الصّادقُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): أوحَى اللّهُ تعالى إلى موسى (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): يا موسى ، اشكُرْني حَقَّ شُكرِي ، فقالَ: يا ربِّ كيفَ أشكُرُكَ حَقَّ شُكرِكَ ، وليسَ مِن شُكرٍ أشكُرُكَ بهِ إلّا وأنتَ أنعَمتَ بهِ عَلَيَّ ؟ ! فقالَ: يا موسى شَكَرتَني حَقَّ شُكري حينَ عَلِمتَ أنَّ ذلكَ مِنّي.
_source.english: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) said, ‘Allah, most High, revealed to Prophet Moses (AS) saying, ‘O Moses, thank Me with the thanks that is due to Me. Moses asked, ‘O Lord, but how can I thank You with the thanks that is due to You, when every single expression of thanks that I may convey has been bestowed upon Me by You? He replied, ‘O Moses, you thank Me with the thanks that is due to Me when you acknowledge that it is indeed from Me.
_source.cited_from: Qasas al-Anbiya li al-Rawandi, p. 161, number:178

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): شُكرُ كُلِّ نِعمَةٍ الوَرَعُ عن مَحارِمِ اللّهِ.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘[True] thanksgiving for every bounty lies in restraining oneself from the things that Allah has prohibited.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): إذا قَدَرتَ على عَدُوِّكَ فَاجعَلْ العَفوَ عَنهُ شُكراً لِلقُدرَةِ علَيهِ.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘When you vanquish your enemy, let your pardon of him serve as thanksgiving for the power [given to you] over him.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ الباقرُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): اِستَكثِرْ لِنفسِكَ مِنَ اللّهِ قليلَ الرِّزقِ تَخَلُّصاً إلى الشُّكرِ.
_source.english: Imam al-Baqir (AS) said, ‘Regard even a little sustenance from Allah as too much for yourself by way of sincere thanksgiving.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ الصّادقُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): شُكرُ النِّعمَةِ اجتِنابُ المَحارِمِ ، وتَمامُ الشُّكرِ قولُ الرجُلِ: الحَمدُ للّهِ رَبِّ العالَمِينَ .
_source.english: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) said, ‘Thanksgiving for a bounty is accomplished through avoidance of prohibited things, and an expression of complete thanks is when a man says, ‘All praise belongs to Allah, the Lord of the worlds.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ الصّادقُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): مَن أنعَمَ اللّهُ علَيهِ بنِعمَةٍ فَعَرَفَها بقَلبِهِ ، فقد أدّى شُكرَها .
_source.english: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) said, ‘He whom Allah favours with the bestowal of a bounty and who then acknowledges it with his heart has conveyed [true] thanks for it.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ الصّادقُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): كانَ رسولُ اللّهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ) إذا وَرَدَ علَيهِ أمرٌ يَسُرُّهُ قالَ: الحَمدُ للّهِ على هذِهِ النِّعمَةِ ، وإذا وَرَدَ علَيهِ أمرٌ يَغتَمُّ بهِ قالَ: الحَمدُ للّهِ على كُلِّ حالٍ .
_source.english: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) narrated, ‘When the Prophet (SAWA) was faced with a situation that pleased him, he used to say, ‘Praise be to Allah for this bounty, and when he was faced with a situation that made him sorrowful, he used to say, ‘Praise be to Allah in every situation.

_source.arabic: مصباح الشريعة ـ فيما نسبه إلى الإمام الصّادق (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) ـ: أدنَى الشُّكرِ رُؤيَةُ النِّعمَةِ مِنَ اللّهِ مِن غَيرِ عِلّةٍ يَتَعَلَّقُ القَلبُ بها دُونَ اللّهِ والرِّضا بما أعطاه، وأن لا تَعصِيَهُ بِنِعمَتِهِ و تُخالِفَهُ بِشيءٍ مِن أمرِهِ ونَهيِهِ بِسَبَبِ نِعمَتِهِ .
_source.english: It is narrated in Misbah al-Shariaa (The Lantern of the Path): ‘The lowest level of thankfulness is to see the bounty as coming from Allah irrespective of its cause, and without attaching the heart to any other cause save Allah, Mighty and Exalted. It consists of being satisfied with what is given, and not disobeying Him by means of His bounty, nor opposing Him in any of His commands and prohibitions as a result of that bounty.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): أشكَرُ الناسِ أقنَعُهُم ، وأكفَرُهُم لِلنِّعَمِ أجشَعُهُم.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘The most thankful of people is he who is most content whilst the most ungrateful of people is he who is most covetous.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ زينُ العابدينَ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): أشكَرُكُم للّهِ أشكَرُكُم للناسِ.
_source.english: Imam Zayn al-Abidin (AS) said, ‘The most thankful among you to Allah is he who is most thankful towards people.

_source.chapter: Enjoinment of Thanking One Who Does Good To You
_source.arabic: الإمامُ الحسنُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): اللُّؤمُ أن لا تَشكُرَ النِّعمَةَ.
_source.english: Imam al-Hasan (AS) said, ‘It is blameworthy that you do not thank for a favour done unto you.

_source.chapter: Enjoinment of Thanking One Who Does Good To You
_source.arabic: الإمامُ زينُ العابدينَ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): أمّا حَقُّ ذِي المَعروفِ علَيكَ فأن تَشكُرَهُ وتَذكُرَ مَعروفَهُ ، وتُكسِبَهُ المَقالَةَ الحَسَنَةَ ، وتُخلِصَ لَهُ الدعاءَ فيما بينَكَ وبينَ اللّهِ عَزَّوجلَّ ، فإذا فَعَلتَ ذلكَ كنتَ قد شَكَرتَهُ سِرّاً وعَلانِيَةً ، ثُمّ إن قَدَرْتَ على مُكافَأتِهِ يَوماً كافَيتَهُ.
_source.english: Imam Zayn al-Abidin (AS) said, ‘The right of he who does a kindly act towards you is that you thank him and mention his kindness; that you reward him with beautiful words and supplicate for him sincerely in that which is between you and Allah. If you do that, you have thanked him both secretly and openly. Then if you are able to repay him one day, repay him.

_source.chapter: One Who Has Not Thanked the Creature Has Not Thanked The Creator
_source.arabic: الإمامُ زينُ العابدينَ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): يقولُ اللّهُ تباركَ وتعالى لِعبدٍ مِن عَبِيدِهِ يَومَ القِيامَةِ: أشَكَرتَ فُلانا ؟ فيقولُ: بَل شَكَرتُكَ يا ربِّ ، فيقولُ: لَم تَشكُرْني إذ لَم تَشكُرْهُ .
_source.english: Imam Zayn al-Abidin (AS) said, ‘Allah will ask one of His servants on the Day of Resurrection, ‘Did you thank x?, and the servant will reply, ‘No, but I thanked You instead, O Lord. Allah will reply, ‘You have not thanked Me as long as you have not thanked him.
_source.chapter_ar: مَن لَم يَشكُرِ المَخلوقَ لَم يَشكُرِ الخالِقَ

_source.chapter: One Who Has Not Thanked the Creature Has Not Thanked The Creator
_source.arabic: الإمامُ الصّادقُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): لَعَنَ اللّهُ قاطِعِي سَبيلِ المَعروفِ ، وهُو الرجُلُ يُصنَعُ إلَيهِ المَعروفُ فَيَكفُرُهُ ، فَيَمنَعُ صاحِبَهُ مِن أن يَصنَعَ ذلكَ إلى غَيرِهِ .
_source.english: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) said, ‘Allah curses the one who cuts of the means to kindly acts, who is such that when someone does him a good turn, he is ungrateful and as a result, he deters that person from ever doing the same towards anyone else.
_source.chapter_ar: مَن لَم يَشكُرِ المَخلوقَ لَم يَشكُرِ الخالِقَ

_source.chapter: One Who Has Not Thanked the Creature Has Not Thanked The Creator
_source.arabic: الإمامُ الرِّضا (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): مَن لَم يَشكُرِ المُنعِمَ مِنَ المَخلوقينَ لَم يَشكُرِ اللّهَ عَزَّوجلَّ .
_source.english: Imam al-Rida (AS) said, ‘Whoever does not thank the one who does him a favor from among Allahs creatures has not thanked Allah either.
_source.chapter_ar: مَن لَم يَشكُرِ المَخلوقَ لَم يَشكُرِ الخالِقَ
_source.cited_from: Uyoun Akhbar al-Ridha (AS), volume:2, p. 24, number:2

_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): استَحسِنُوا أسماءَكُم ؛ فإنّكُم تُدعَوْنَ بها يَومَ القِيامَةِ: قُمْ يا فُلانَ ابنَ فُلانٍ إلى نورِكَ ، وقُمْ يا فُلانَ ابنَ فُلانٍ لا نُورَ لَكَ.
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, 'Keep good names for yourselves, for verily you will be called by them on the Day of Resurrection: Come O x son of x towards your light, or: O x son of x, there is no light for you.

_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): سَمُّوا أولادَكُم أسماءَ الأنبياءِ.
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, 'Name your children after the prophets.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ الصّادقُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) ـ لَمّا سُئلَ عنِ التَّسميَةِ بِأسماءِ الأئمّةِ ، أفِي ذلك نَفعٌ ؟ ـ: إي واللّهِ ، وهَلِ الدِّينُ إلّا الحُبُّ ؟! قالَ اللّهُ: «إنْ كُنْتُمْ تُحِبُّونَ اللّهَ فاتَّبِعُوني يُحبِبْكُمُ اللّهُ ويَغفِرْ لَكُمْ ذُنُوبَكُم».
_source.english: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) was once asked with regards to naming [one's children] after the Imams (AS) and whether there was any benefit in doing so, to which he replied, 'Of course, by Allah, and is religion anything but love?! Allah has said, "Say, 'If you love Allah, then follow me; Allah will love you and forgive you your sins, and Allah is all-forgiving, all-merciful.”

_source.arabic: الإمامُ الكاظمُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): أوَّلُ ما يَبَرُّ الرَّجُلُ وَلَدَهُ أن يُسَمِّيَهُ بِاسمٍ حَسَنٍ، فَلْيُحَسِّنْ أحَدُكُمُ اسمَ وَلَدِهِ .
_source.english: Imam al-Kazim (AS) said, 'The very first act of kindness of a man towards his son is to give him a good name, so keep good names for your children.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ الباقرُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): كانَ رسولُ اللّهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ) يُغَيِّرُ الأسماءَ القَبيحَةَ في الرِّجالِ والبُلدانِ .
_source.english: Imam al-Baqir (AS) narrated, 'The Prophet (SAWA) used to change ugly names of people and places [to good names].

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): التفكُّرُ يَدعُو إلَى البِرِّ والعَمَلِ بهِ.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘Thinking instigates goodness and action upon it.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): مَن تَفَكَّرَ أبصَرَ.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘He who thinks perceives.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): مَن أكثَرَ الفِكرَ فيما تَعَلَّمَ أتقَنَ عِلمَهُ، وفَهِمَ ما لم يَكُن يَفهَمُ.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘Whoever increases his thinking in whatever he learns, his knowledge will become proficient, and he will come to understand whatever he did not understand before.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): لا عِلمَ كالتَّفكُّرِ .
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘There is no knowledge like thinking.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): الفِكرُ مِرآةٌ صافِيَةٌ.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘Thinking is a transparent mirror.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ الحسنُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): التفكُّرُ حَياةُ قَلبِ البَصيرِ.
_source.english: Imam Hasan (AS) said, ‘Thinking is the life of the heart of the cognizant.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ الحسنُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): اُوصيكُم بتَقوَى اللّهِ وإدامَةِ التَّفَكُّرِ ؛ فإنَّ التَّفَكُّرَ أبو كُلِّ خَيرٍ واُمُّهُ.
_source.english: Imam Hasan (AS) said, ‘I advise you with Godwariness and continuous thinking, for thinking is the father and mother of all good.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ الصّادقُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): الفِكرَةُ مِرآةُ الحَسَناتِ وكَفّارَةُ السَّيّئاتِ.
_source.english: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) said, ‘A thought is the mirror of merits and the penance for vices.

_source.chapter: There Is No Worship like Thinking
_source.arabic: اُمُّ أبي ذَرٍّ ـ وقد سُئلَت عن عِبادَةِ أبي ذَرٍّ ـ: كانَ نَهارَهُ أجمَعَ يَتفكَّرُ في ناحِيَةٍ عن الناسِ.
_source.english: The mother of Abu Dharr when asked about the worship of Abu Dharr, said, ‘He spent his whole day thinking in a place far away from people.

_source.chapter: There Is No Worship like Thinking
_source.arabic: الإمامُ الصّادقُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): أفضَلُ العِبادَةِ إدمانُ التَّفكُّرِ في اللّهِ وفي قُدرَتِهِ.
_source.english: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) said, ‘The best of worship is perpetually thinking about Allah and His power.

_source.chapter: There Is No Worship like Thinking
_source.arabic: الإمامُ الصّادقُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): تَفَكُّرُ ساعَةٍ خَيرٌ مِن عِبادَةِ سَنَةٍ «إنَّما يَتَذَكَّرُ اُولُوا الأَلبابِ».
_source.english: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) said, ‘Thinking for an hour is better than worshipping for a year, for “Only those who possess intellect take admonition” (Quran 39:9).

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): مَن قَلَّ أكلُهُ صَفا فِكرُهُ.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘Whoever eats less, their thought will be more purified.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): كيفَ تَصفُو فِكرَةُ مَن يَستَديمُ الشِّبَعَ؟!
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘How can ones thought be purified if they are constantly full.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): الفِكرُ في غَيرِ الحِكمَةِ هَوَسٌ.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘Thinking outside [the bounds] of wisdom is fantasy.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): مَن كَثُرَ فِكرُهُ في المَعاصي دَعَتهُ إلَيها.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘Whoever thinks much about sins, will be prompted to commit them.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): مَن تَفَكَّرَ في ذاتِ اللّهِ أَبلَسَ.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘Whoever thinks about the Grandeur of Allah will fail.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): حَسْبُ المَرءِ ... مِن عِرفانِهِ، عِلمُهُ بِزَمانِهِ.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, 'The worth of a man with regards to his perception of things is his knowledge of [the workings of] time.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): أعرَفُ الناسِ بالزّمانِ ، مَن لَم يَتَعَجَّبْ مِن أحداثِهِ.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, 'The man who best understands time is he who is not taken aback by its proceedings.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ الصّادقُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): العالِمُ بِزَمانِهِ، لا تَهجُمُ علَيهِ اللَّوابِسُ.
_source.english: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) said, 'He who knows [the workings of] his time is never overwhelmed by its obscurities.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): مَن وَثِقَ بِالزَّمانِ صُرِعَ.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, 'He who places his trust in time has gone mad.
_source.cited_from: Uyoun Akhbar al-Ridha (AS), volume:2, p. 54, number:204

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): مَن أمَنَ الزَمانَ خانَهُ، ومَن أعظَمَهُ أهانَهُ .
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, 'Whoever trusts time is betrayed by it, and whoever holds it in high esteem is abased by it.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): مَن أمَنَ الزَّمانَ خانَهُ، ومَن تَعَظَّمَ علَيهِ أهانَهُ ، ومَن تَرَغَّمَ علَيهِ أرغَمَهُ ، ومَن لَجَأَ إلَيهِ أسلَمَهُ ، ولَيسَ كُلُّ مَن رَمى أصابَ ، وإذا تَغَيَّرَ السُّلطانُ تَغَيَّرَ الزَّمانُ .
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, 'Whoever trusts time is betrayed by it, whoever attaches great importance to it is abased by it, whoever is angry with time, it spites him even more, and whoever takes refuge with time is forsaken by it. Not everyone who throws hits the target. When the sultan changes so does the time.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): الزَّمانُ يَخُونُ صاحِبَهُ ، ولا يَستَعتِبُ لِمَن عاتَبَهُ.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, 'Time betrays the one who believes he possesses time, and it does not seek to please the one who blames it.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): مَن تَشاغَلَ بالزَّمانِ شَغَلَهُ.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, 'Whoever preoccupies himself with time is occupied by it in turn.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): مَن عَتَبَ عَلى الزمانِ طالَت مَعتَبَتُهُ.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, 'He who blames time will find no end to his frustration.
_source.cited_from: Uyoun Akhbar al-Ridha (AS), volume:2, p. 53, number:204

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): مَن عانَدَ الزَّمانَ أرغَمَهُ، ومَنِ استَسلَمَ إلَيهِ لَم يَسلَمْ.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, 'Whoever resists time is spited by it even more, and whoever surrenders to it is not safe either.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): مَن كابَرَ الزَّمانَ عَطِبَ، ومن يَنقِمْ علَيهِ غَضِبَ.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, 'Whoever contends with time is thwarted, and whoever is resentful towards it ends up getting angry himself.

_source.arabic: عيون أخبار الرِّضا عن الرَّيّانِ بنِ الصَّلتِ: أنشَدَنِي الرِّضا (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) لعبدِالمُطَّلِبِ: يَعِيبُ الناسُ كُلُّهُمُ زَماناً / وما لِزَمانِنا عَيبٌ سِوانا / نَعِيبُ زَمانَنا والعَيبُ فِينا / ولو نَطَقَ الزَّمانُ بِنا هَجانا / وإنَّ الذِئبَ يَترُكُ لَحمَ ذِئبٍ / ويَأكُلُ بَعضُنا بَعضا عِيانا / لَبِسْنا لِلخداعِ مسوكَ طِيبٍ / ووَيلٌ لِلغَرِيبِ إذا أتانا.
_source.english: Al-Rayyan b. al-Salt narrated that Imam al-Rida (AS) recited some verses he had composed for Aabd al-Muttalib: All of people place the blame on time, / When the trouble with time is only ourselves; / We reprove time while the fault lies within us, / If time could speak, it would surely mock us. / The wolf shuns the meat of a fellow wolf, / Whereas we devour each other in broad daylight. / Attired to deceive with our polished teeth, / Yet woe betide the stranger when he approaches us.
_source.cited_from: Uyoun Akhbar al-Ridha (AS), volume:2, p. 177, number:5

_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ) : مَن أدّى إلى اُمَّتي حَديثا يُقامُ بِه سُنّةٌ أو يُثْلَمُ بهِ بِدْعَةٌ فَلهُ الجَنّةُ.
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, ‘Whoever transmits to my people one tradition by which a practice is established or a heresy is blocked, will enter Paradise.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ الباقرُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : إنَّ حَديثَنا يُحْيي القُلوبَ.
_source.english: Imam al-Baqir (AS) said, ‘Truly our tradition enlivens the hearts.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ الباقرُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : لَحَديثٌ واحِدٌ تأخُذُهُ عن صادِقٍ خَيرٌ لَكَ من الدُّنيا وما فِيها.
_source.english: Imam al-Baqir (AS) said, ‘Indeed one true tradition that you receive from a truthful person is better for you than the whole world and all that it contains.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ الصّادقُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : اعرِفُوا مَنازِلَ النّاسِ مِنّا على قَدْرِ رِواياتِهم عَنّا .
_source.english: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) said, ‘Know the peoples positions with respect to us through the amount of their narration of our traditions.
